verdict.rationale: Twenty documents REST and GraphQL APIs over the CRM data model and lists an MCP server on every plan. Connected mailboxes link emails to Company and People records, and the built-in AI can query and summarize CRM records, so an agent has documented access to the pieces of an account brief. However, the MCP server appears only as a pricing-table line, and nothing shows that email or activity-history data is exposed through the API or MCP, or that a pre-meeting brief can be compiled this way. missing for 10: MCP server tool/scope documentation, explicit API/MCP access to linked emails and timeline history, a documented account-brief or meeting-prep workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: Both GraphQL and REST endpoints, with auto-generated documentation per workspace.
Emails are automatically linked to the matching Company and People records
The AI chatbot can query your CRM records, summarize information, and help you find what you're looking for without building complex filters.
